limits: Local mechanical examples only. Reproduce using scripts/validation/clicko-motion-*.py. Source reports are in output/motion-capability-cycle-2026-11-17. No professional finish, listening, full material system, physical shadows or volumetric CGI qualification. Different builds must be requalified.

examples.observation: 30 native frames; expected linear trajectory within 0.023 pixels; no adjacent identical frames. Does not measure interactive playback performance.
Rectangular mask clips a solid; animated width reveals it at frames 0,15,29. Other mask types/feather/mattes unqualified.
50 percent opacity and Multiply alter solid compositing at frames 0,15,29.
Default Ramp and Drop Shadow produce visible changes. Surface shading and contact/height response not qualified.
sourceRectAtTime-derived anchor centers full MOTION text at frames 0,15,29; uncorrected test crops initial letters. Exact chosen font and animated text still need inspection.
Y rotation changes a 3D-enabled plane's perspective; animated camera changes image; zero light intensity darkens plane. Not volumetric geometry or physical material qualification.
One-second native camera fixture exports 30 decoded frames at 30/1 fps with regular timestamps. Native versus MP4 differences measured at frames 0,15,29; no whole-film or UI playback guarantee.

Native WAV offset exports attacks at 0.200021 and 0.700021 seconds. Same-fixture A/B confirms keyed gains -6/-12 dB; old build holds -6 dB for both. Initially muted envelope also passes. PCM 48 kHz stereo, one second; no listening or mixing qualification.
